E2238

The debug view is from an earlier stop: {detail}.

What

The debug view is from an earlier stop: {detail}.

Why

A frame, scope or variable reference names what one stop showed; once the program runs again, those frames and values are gone, so the reference names nothing.

Fix

Refresh the editor's stack and variables after the next stop.
